Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: EmoteLink
Description: A plain Penumbra animation launcher with temporary activation, target alignment, and synchronized group play.
Punchline: Pick an emote, link up, and play together.
Changelog: Updated the in-plugin How To guide for the redesigned interface, with annotated walkthroughs for rooms, readiness, color states, purple suggestions, Ready/Solo/Send actions, role labels and corrections, and private mods.
